description: Synthetic public learning benchmark. Expected sources label relevance, not generated-answer correctness.

documents.rag.txt: Retrieval augmented generation retrieves relevant document passages and supplies this context to a language model. RAG answers should cite supporting sources. Retrieval does not train the language model.
documents.vectors.txt: Embeddings represent text meaning as numerical vectors. Cosine similarity compares vector directions; cosine distance is one minus cosine similarity. Lower cosine distance means closer vectors. A vector database stores embeddings and metadata.
documents.tls.txt: TLS encrypts network traffic in transit. Certificate validation checks the server identity against trusted certificate authorities. Expired certificates can cause a TLS handshake failure.
documents.backups.txt: Create database backups while the backend is stopped. Restore the backup into a separate directory and verify document counts. Recovery removes unfinished imports after an interrupted process.
documents.chunks.txt: Chunking splits long documents into smaller text passages. Chunk overlap preserves context around passage boundaries. PDF page numbers are retained in metadata so readers can locate evidence.
documents.versions.txt: Document replacement creates a new version of the same source. The previous version becomes superseded only after indexing succeeds. Failed replacement leaves the previous document active.
documents.commands.txt:
helm install demo ./chart --namespace sandbox
podman pull example.test/app:1.0.4-3
podman pull example.test/app:1.0.4-30

documents.garden.txt: Tomatoes grow in well drained soil with sufficient sunlight. Water plants near their roots and check soil moisture regularly.

queries.query: Why does RAG retrieve document passages?
